content.title: Blaze Pizza: Pi Day 2024
content.text: How it WorksEverything you need to know about how Pi Day will go---------------------------------How do I get my $3.14 Pizza?All you need to do is show up in-restaurant on Thursday, 3/14/24! You do not need any reward or promotion to redeem.We strongly recommend you join Blaze Rewards to receive access to all of our exclusive offers and promotions after Pi Day, however joining Blaze Rewards is not a requirement to receive your $3.14 Pizza on Pi Day. Simply head to a Blaze Pizza location near you and order any 11-inch Pizza to receive it for $3.14 at the counter! How many Pizzas can I get with the $3.14 Pi Day offer?One 11-inch Pizza per person. Any additional Pizzas ordered will be regular price. The Pi Day offer is valid for original dough only. Upcharge for specialty crusts still apply.Can I order online or through the app?While our standard online ordering will be available on March 14, to receive the Pi Day offer you must order your Pizza with us in-restaurant.Are house-made gluten-free dough, Keto and Cauliflower crust included?The Pi Day offer is valid on original dough for 11-inch Pizzas only. There will still be an upcharge for all crust upgrades.Is High-Rise dough free?There will still be an upcharge for all crust upgrades.Can I get a Large Pizza with my Pi Day offer?The Pi Day Offer is only valid on one 11-inch Pizza per person.When can I use the Pi Day offer?The Pi Day offer will be available in participating restaurants on Thursday, March 14th only.Which Blaze Pizza locations are participating in the $3.14 Pi Day offer?See below for a list of non-participating U.S. locations.I showed up at 7PM and the restaurant was closed.Please keep in mind hours vary by location. Please check your local Blaze Pizza location for hours.
